title: Kennewick WA Photographer | It's A Keeper Photography
description: Golden-hour photography in Kennewick, WA — seniors, families, newborns and branding. Sessions at Columbia Park, the riverfront and the spots locals love.

hero.heading: Your Kennewick, WA Photographer
hero.intro: Senior pictures, family sessions, newborns and branding photography in Kennewick — photographed in the warm evening light this side of the river does so well.
hero.imageAlt: Children photographed outdoors in warm golden-hour light during a Tri-Cities family session
hero.secondaryImageAlt: Senior portrait photographed outdoors in warm autumn light in the Tri-Cities

sections.heading: Minutes Away, Twenty Years Familiar
paragraphs: I'm based in Richland, just across the river — which means Kennewick families get a local photographer, not a visitor. I've photographed seniors, families and business owners here for two decades: sessions in Columbia Park as the sun drops over the water, branding shoots in downtown Kennewick's shops, and family evenings in the hills where the grass turns to gold.
sections.imageAlt: Family photographed outdoors in the Columbia Basin during golden hour
sections.secondaryImageAlt: Lisa photographing a portrait session outdoors in the Tri-Cities

items.heading: Columbia Park and the riverfront
paragraphs: Miles of shoreline, big trees, open lawns and river light — room for kids to run and for golden hour to do its thing.
items.imageAlt: Family with a baby photographed outside in warm Tri-Cities light

items.heading: Vineyards, hills and golden edges
paragraphs: The edges of Kennewick toward the hills give us dry grasses, long shadows and that warm eastern-Washington glow that photographs like honey.
items.imageAlt: Senior portrait photographed in a dry golden landscape in the Tri-Cities

items.heading: A place that's already yours
paragraphs: Your neighborhood park, your grandparents' backyard, the field behind your church. Bring me somewhere that already holds a memory.
items.imageAlt: Family sharing a candid laugh during a black-and-white portrait session

items.heading: What time are Kennewick sessions?
paragraphs: Golden hour — roughly the last hour before sunset, when the light over the Columbia turns warm and soft.
